pmc-13438182.title: Non‐Contiguous Double Thyroglossal Duct Cysts: A Case Report
pmc-13438182.creator: Baogang Wang, Bo Sun, Shujun Li, Lurong Han
pmc-13438182.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Thyroglossal duct cysts (TDCs) are conventionally considered solitary lesions connected to a persistent embryological tract. While rare double TDCs have been reported, they are almost invariably anatomically continuous. We report a paradigm‐shifting case of non‐contiguous double TDCs in a 50‐year‐old male, featuring two anatomically discrete cysts at the left vallecula and infrahyoid region with no interconnecting tract, to our knowledge, a finding not previously documented in this distinct anatomical configuration. Both lesions were completely excised and pathologically confirmed.
